task.title: Fix common problems
task.shortdesc: What to do when a draft, a status or the page doesn't do what you expect.

step.cmd: If the page says today's public drafts are used up, read the latest run it shows, or draft from an issue instead.
If a topic is a stub, write it: it is new in this generation and has no sibling.

info.p: Each section's draft comment lists the facts to cover.

step.cmd: If alignr/grounding fails after you edit, check every number you typed: give it a key, or add the fact with its source to the facts file.
If alignr/open-questions fails, search the topic for disposition="open" and close each question you have answered.
If alignr/dita-ot fails, run alignr stage drafts/tpu7x/topics --to build/tpu and build build/tpu/tpu.ditamap with DITA-OT to see the message.
If a topic is withheld, report it as an issue: the serialiser should never write invalid DITA.
